title: S-Parameters Mixer
text: Model mixer and local oscillator using S-parameters, {Interpolation method} sets Method to interpolate network parameters; {S-Parameters} sets the s-parameters for nonlinear mixer, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of S-parameters 2.0e9, {Reference Impedance (ohms)} sets the reference impedance of S-parameters, {Mixer Type} sets the type of mixer, {LO frequency (Hz)} sets the local oscillator frequency 0.9e9, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} sets the phase noise frequency offset, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise level, {Noise type} sets the type of noise data, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the available signal-to-noise ratio at the input to available signal-to-noise ratio, {Minimum noise figure} sets the minimum ratio of available signal-to-noise ratio at input to available signal-to-noise ratio, {Optimal reflection coefficient} sets the optimal source impedance, {Equivalent normalized noise resistance} sets the normalized resistance values used to take noise, {Noise factor} sets the ratio of available signal-to-noise power at input to available signal-to-noise power, {Noise temperature (K)} sets the equivalent temperature that produces same amount of noise, {IP3 type} sets the type of third order, {IP3 (dBm)} sets the iP3 value, {1dB gain compression power (dBm)} sets the output power value at which gain has decreased by 1 dB, {Output saturation power (dBm)} sets the output power value that mixer produces when fully saturated, {Gain compression at saturation (dB)} sets the decrease in gain value, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source Same, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

params.values: S-parameters for nonlinear mixer [0,0;1,0] (default) | 2-by-2-by- M array
